rationale: Preserve archived comparative test driver; permanent host/store/journal/watcher suite remains a separate pending review.

cases.title: guarded production baseline transform
cases.reason: Reverse only recorded acquisition forwarding/catchup/restart patch; hash before/current/test sources and reject retired or changed source.

cases.title: narrow temporary actual-suite runners
cases.reason: Bundle historical runProcess; generate before/after Vite configs that select the real transcript suite, substituting only selected source and cleaning all scratch/module cache.

cases.title: before runner evidence
cases.reason: Parse real Vitest JSON report; collect passing/failing counts and case names. Expected baseline contrast: before 6 failed / 1 passed, after 7 passed.

cases.title: after runner evidence and aggregate comparison
cases.reason: Compare final reported pass/fail counts to expected contrast before 6 failed / 1 passed, after 7 passed. Historical driver count controls do not replace reading every supporting suite body.
